problem_title: What is the maximum number of items in a SOQL IN clause?
problem: Oracle has a limit of 1000 items for its IN clause. Is there a similar limit in SOQL? The SF documentation on the IN clause does not mention any limit. To clarify the definition of an item, the following example has 2 items in its IN clause: the above code was taken from the linked SF documentation.
code:
SELECT Name FROM Widget__c
WHERE Name IN ('Ring', 'Flange')
explanation: I think you are limited to the size of the query not exceeding 20,000 characters. https://developer.salesforce.com/docs/atlas.en-us.salesforce_app_limits_cheatsheet.meta/salesforce_app_limits_cheatsheet/salesforce_app_limits_platform_soslsoql.htm SOQL statements can't exceed 20,000 characters.
